insert into rpt_off_balance_sheet ( contract_id, cashflow_id, times, due_date, due_amount, principal, interest, amortization_date, period_name, amortization_amount, finance_income, act_amortization_amount, act_finance_income, off_balance_sheet_amount, write_off_due_amount, write_off_principal, write_off_interest, original_obs_amount, object_version_number, request_id, program_id, created_by, creation_date, last_updated_by, last_update_date, last_update_login)
( SELECT #{item.contractId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} contract_id, #{item.cashflowId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} cashflow_id, #{item.times,jdbcType=NUMERIC} times, #{item.dueDate,jdbcType=DATE} due_date, #{item.dueAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC} due_amount, #{item.principal,jdbcType=NUMERIC} principal, #{item.interest,jdbcType=NUMERIC} interest, #{item.amortizationDate,jdbcType=DATE} amortization_date, #{item.periodName,jdbcType=VARCHAR} period_name, #{item.amortizationAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC} amortization_amount, #{item.financeIncome,jdbcType=NUMERIC} finance_income, #{item.actAmortizationAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC} act_amortization_amount, #{item.actFinanceIncome,jdbcType=NUMERIC} act_finance_income, #{item.offBalanceSheetAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC} off_balance_sheet_amount, #{item.writeOffDueAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC} write_off_due_amount, #{item.writeOffPrincipal,jdbcType=NUMERIC} write_off_principal, #{item.writeOffInterest,jdbcType=NUMERIC} write_off_interest, #{item.originalObsAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC} original_obs_amount, 1 object_version_number, 1 request_id, 1 program_id, 1 created_by, sysdate creation_date, 1 last_updated_by, sysdate last_update_date, 1 last_update_login from dual)

select t1.*, (@i :=@i + 1) AS index_number from (SELECT t.amortization_date,
CASE WHEN t.act_amortization_amount < 0 THEN t.act_amortization_amount * -1 ELSE 0 END AS inflow_amount, CASE WHEN t.act_amortization_amount > 0 THEN t.act_amortization_amount ELSE 0 END AS outflow_amount,
t.off_balance_sheet_amount FROM rpt_off_balance_sheet t,(SELECT @i := 0) AS row_seq
t.off_balance_sheet_amount IS NOT NULL AND t.act_amortization_amount IS NOT NULL and t.contract_id = #{contractId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}
ORDER BY t.amortization_date) t1
